JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Welcome to the Orange Islands
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Meet Professor Ivy on Valencia Island, then sail to Mikan Island for your first Orange Crew badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Orange Crew
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Win the Coral-Eye, Sea Ruby, Spike Shell and Jade Star Badges from Cissy, Danny, Rudy and Luana.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Orange League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Beat Drake's full six-Pokemon team at Pummelo Stadium to win the Winner's Trophy.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pink Pokemon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Stop Team Rocket on Pinkan Island and earn Officer Jenny's permit to catch Pinkan Pokemon.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Crystal Onix
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Mateo on Sunburst Island says a glass-clear Onix lives in the Crystal Cave.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Chosen One
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Gather the treasures of Fire, Ice and Lightning Islands and bring them to the Shamouti Shrine.

lines: Professor Ivy: Welcome to Valencia Island, Champion!
I study how Pokemon here differ from Kanto's. Some are new colors, some grow bigger!
Before you go, I have a favor. I found this strange ball, and nobody can open it.
Kurt in Azalea Town knows Poke Balls better than anyone. Would you take it to Johto?
They say a Pokemon that travels through time lives in Ilex Forest...
done: Professor Ivy: The four Orange Crew Gyms are on Mikan, Navel, Trovita and Kumquat.
Win all four badges, then challenge Drake at Pummelo Stadium!

lines: A young Lapras is stranded in the shallows, crying for its herd.
You stay with it all afternoon. It doesn't want to leave your side!

fail: Tracey: I'm a Pokemon Watcher! Win a badge, then I'd love to sketch your team in battle.
lines: Tracey: You won Cissy's badge! Let me watch your Pokemon up close. Battle me!

player_won: Tracey: Amazing! I'll call this sketch Champion in Action.

done: Tracey: My sketchbook is filling up with your Pokemon!

player_lost: Cissy: Better work on that aim. Come back any time!

player_won: Rudy: Brilliant! The Spike Shell Badge suits you.

player_won: Luana: Wonderful teamwork! You've earned the Jade Star Badge.
Now you may challenge Drake at Pummelo Stadium.

intro: Drake: I'm Drake, Supreme Gym Leader of the Orange League.
Nobody has beaten my six Pokemon in a full battle. Show me what you've got!
player_won: Drake: Incredible... My Dragonite has finally met its match.
The Winner's Trophy is yours, Orange League Champion!
player_lost: Drake: A good battle, but the trophy stays here. Train and come back!

requirements.fail_text: Only trainers with all four Orange Crew badges may challenge Drake.

lines: Officer Jenny: Pinkan Island is a protected reserve.
The Pinkan Berries here turn the Pokemon pink! Poachers want them badly.
Team Rocket was spotted in the reserve. Please, stop them!
done: Officer Jenny: Team Rocket is somewhere in the reserve. Be careful!

lines: Officer Jenny: You chased off Team Rocket! The reserve is safe again.
Here's a research permit. You may catch Pinkan Pokemon to study them.
Treat them kindly. They only turn pink thanks to the berries here!

lines: Jessie and James are stuffing Pinkan Berries into sacks!
Team Rocket: Pink Pokemon will make us rich! Out of our way!

player_won: Team Rocket: We're blasting off again!

lines: Mateo: Welcome to Sunburst Island, the island of glass!
A Crystal Onix lives in the cave by the lake. Its body is clear as glass.
Water and Electric attacks pass right through it. Only fire can crack it.
If you can calm it down, come back. I'll make you something special.
done: Mateo: The Crystal Onix is in the cave by the lake. Good luck!

lines: Mateo: You calmed the Crystal Onix! I've never seen glass shine like that.
I made this glass coin from sand by the lake. It's said to bring good fortune!
And this Crystal Stone: an Onix that touches it turns to living crystal, like the one in the cave!

lines: Melody: Welcome to the festival! Have you heard our island's legend?
Three titans of fire, ice and lightning must never fight.
If they do, only the guardian of the sea can stop them, and it needs help.
The legend says a Chosen One will gather a treasure from each titan's island.
You came by sea on festival day... I think you're the Chosen One!
Bring the three treasures to the Shrine, and the guardian will sing.
done: Melody: Fire Island, Ice Island, Lightning Island. Then the Shrine!
